## Issue 1: set_outlier bug: idem que tramo seats

### Issue outliers automatically detected in x13 : OK 

but spec structure different from TS worth to be noted 

```{r}

library("rjd3toolkit")
library("rjd3x13")
myspec_x13 <- x13_spec("RSA5") 

# before modifying spec 
myspec_x13$regarima$outlier$outliers


myspec_x13 <- set_outlier(
  myspec_x13,
  outliers.type = "LS"
)

# after modifying spec 
myspec_x13$regarima$outlier$outliers


myspec_x13 <- set_outlier(
  myspec_x13,
  outliers.type = "SO"
)

# after modifying spec 
myspec_x13$regarima$outlier$outliers

```
